_doc: Angles in degrees. Absolute 0 = down, +90 = forward (side view). Limbs are the character's own right and left; the side view shows the right side nearer the viewer, the front view (derived from the side pose by the renderer) faces the viewer, so the right side is on picture-left. spine.lean tilts the whole body forward; chest/neck/head are relative; spine.turn turns the head from the body's own front, + to its right (-90..90). arm.shoulder is relative to the torso's downward line, elbow flexes forward (0..160), knee flexes backward (0..160), ankle is the foot's angle from the ground, not the shin: 0 = flat with toes forward, + lifts the toes (-180..180). arm.hand: fist | out (thumb away from body) | in (thumb toward body) | point (like out, one long finger, shorter grouped fingers). mouth: 1 (slit), 2 (arch), 3 (wide shout). arm.out / leg.out: the whole arm or leg turned out of the paper, + = away from the body sideways (-90..90); side view shortens it by cos(out), front view shows its sideways reach. arm.twist: wrist turn; leg.toe: toe turn. arm.prop (optional, one hand at a time): a held sword, club or bow (kind) along its line through the grip; angle is added to the hand's angle, out to the arm's out; a bow with draw: true has its string pulled to the other hand; grip: both puts the other hand on the hilt below this one (the other arm's angles are then ignored).
